summary: First iteration testing for Cherry Tree Agency landing page. Backend (7/7 pytest tests) and Frontend (all 11 requested flows) passed. POST/GET /api/leads work with validation, MongoDB persistence, newest-first ordering. Landing page renders all 9 sections, 12 features, 4 testimonials, 6 process steps, FAQ accordion opens/closes, testimonial modal opens on card click, header + hero CTAs scroll to apply form, form submission creates lead and shows apply-success + toast, empty submit blocks submission with error toast. No console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); FastAPI recommends lifespan handlers. Non-blocking, low priority.
LeadCreate has no length/format validation beyond EmailStr (e.g., phone/postal_code accept any string). Consider tightening with pydantic Field constraints if abuse becomes a concern.

CORS_ORIGINS default is '*' with allow_credentials=True — this combo is invalid per CORS spec and browsers may reject credentialed requests; not blocking today since app doesn't send credentials, but flag for production hardening.
Feature grid uses data-testid pattern feature-{i} (not feature-card-{i} mentioned in review request). Consistent within codebase; documented for future tests.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_-prefixed leads in Mongo `leads` collection via pytest and UI submission. Safe to leave; can be cleaned by dropping the collection or deleting docs where owner_name starts with 'TEST_'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: https://growth-system-setup.preview.emergentagent.com (from frontend/.env). Feature cards use data-testid="feature-{1..12}" (not feature-card-*). Testimonial modal is a Radix Dialog with data-testid="testimonial-modal" — it's always in the DOM once opened; use isVisible() rather than count() to detect close. Sonner toasts appear in a portal — query with [data-sonner-toaster] * or text-based lookups. Lenis smooth scrolling works fine with data-testid clicks; sticky header offsets scroll target to ~24px, treat that as 'at top'.
